Aquaculture Stewardship Council
Document Name
ASC Farm Standard -
Interpretation Manual 
Document ID ASC-INT-001 Version 1.0 Page 19 of 511
Criterion 1.4 – Traceability and Disclosure
How do I interpret this requirement? 
o The UoC is responsible for ensuring it mitigates risks of substitution and mixing of certified 
and non-certified products. 
o The UoC may use the Risk Assessment Method outlined in Appendix 3 of the ASC Farm 
Standard, Section 3.2, to identify, evaluate and mitigate risks of mixing and substituting ASC 
certified products with non-certified products at all sites (Indicator 1.4.1).
o Certified and non-certified products shall be identifiable and segregated at all sites and at all 
times within the UoC (Indicator 1.4.2(c)). 
• This includes during production while fish are alive.
o Certified products shall be traceable at all sites and at all times within the UoC (Indicator 
1.4.2(d)).
Indicator: Requirement:
1.4.1 The UoC shall identify, evaluate and mitigate risks of mixing and substituting ASC 
certified products with non-certified products at all sites.
1.4.2 The UoC shall develop, implement and maintain a traceability system, covering all sites, 
to ensure that the following conditions are met:
a. only larvae/juveniles that conform with the requirements in Criterion 1.5 are used to 
produce certified product; and
b. all stocked animals are traceable back to the supplier; and
c. all batches of ASC certified and non-certified product are identifiable and segregated 
at all sites and at all times; and
d. all batches of ASC certified product are traceable at all times to: 
o the site(s) used ; and
o the production unit(s) used; and 
e. corrective actions are taken if non-conforming product is identified, sold or 
dispatched; and
f. accompanying documentation shall identify product sold or dispatched as ASC 
certified or non-certified.
